A Hollywood Smile is a complete smile makeover. Depending on your teeth, it combines teeth whitening, veneers or crowns – for example in porcelain or zirconium – to create an even, bright and harmonious smile that suits your face. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the dentist in Istanbul and organises your stay.

A beard or moustache transplant gives a fuller, more defined beard or moustache. Follicles, usually from the back of the head, are transplanted into sparse or hairless areas of the face with the FUE or DHI technique, following the natural direction of growth. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.

A breast lift raises and reshapes sagging breasts – for example after pregnancy, breastfeeding, weight changes or with age – by removing excess skin, tightening the surrounding tissue and placing the nipple higher. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.
A classic infusion with vitamin C, B vitamins, magnesium and calcium to support energy, immunity and general well-being.

A dental implant is a fixed replacement for a missing tooth: a titanium post is placed in the jawbone as an artificial root and, once it has grown into the bone, a custom-made crown is attached. Implants restore chewing function and help to preserve the jawbone. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the dentist in Istanbul and organises your stay.

A non-invasive, low-level light treatment at wavelengths of around 600 to 650 nanometres. The light is absorbed by the follicle cells, stimulates their energy production, improves local circulation and supports healthy hair growth.

A non-surgical option: a soft, saline-filled balloon is placed in the stomach in a short procedure of about 20 minutes, without an operation. It creates a feeling of fullness and helps to reduce food intake; after about four months it deflates and passes naturally. On average it leads to a weight loss of about 10% of body weight and is often a first step on the weight-loss journey.

Algology, or pain medicine, focuses on identifying the source of chronic pain and building a treatment plan around the individual, including pain whose cause is difficult to pin down. At our partner hospital, a pain specialist examines each patient in detail before recommending options, which may combine medical, interventional and lifestyle measures. MedLuxLife arranges the consultation, shares your records in advance and coordinates any follow-up.
All images and reports are stored digitally, shared across the hospital and can be exchanged with imaging centres abroad.

All-on-4 and All-on-6 replace a complete row of teeth in the upper or lower jaw with a fixed bridge on four or six titanium implants – a fixed alternative to removable dentures. With six implants, the biting forces are spread more evenly. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the dentist in Istanbul and organises your stay.
All-on-4 uses four angled implants and makes the most of the available bone. With All-on-6, two additional implants give more stability and spread the biting forces more evenly.
All-on-6 may be recommended where more stability is needed or bone loss is more advanced. Your dentist will advise which option suits you.

An advanced form of FUE in which the channels are opened with blades made of sapphire crystal instead of steel. The finer, sharper blades allow very precise incisions, with less tissue trauma and swelling.
